summoning_body_review.direction_evidence: Same eight-row convention as installed Demon Beast 1/2/3; reviewed Idle/body silhouettes.
summoning_body_review.timing: 15 original samples at authored 12 FPS. The PNG packs provide no FPS, pivot or event markers. Contact/recovery frames below are reviewed execution choices.

ground_pivot.evidence: Authored from paired Idle shadow footprint and all eight support views; image bounds are not the ground plane.

summoning_body_review.shadow_policy: Original separate shadow sheets at existing fixed-rig alpha 0.5.

huntsman_wing_devil_claws.motion: Forward claw sweep at 6; repeated native Claws children reuse this one motion.

summoning_body_review.outcomes: Hit, miss, critical, opportunity and native Multiattack children select the same explicit anatomical row. One emitted attack fact owns one contact; art turns and repeated swipes create no extra native hits. Separate AttackVfx tracks are explicitly empty.
summoning_body_review.movement: Run owns the gait only. Native recorded path/height owns displacement. Jump uses Jump as an explicitly normalized pack jump/roll adaptation. Window uses CrouchWalk with its own frame keys and existing connector passage scale.
summoning_body_review.flight: Original intact selected source poses; authored sole support observations retain one shared visual lift. No reconstructed skeleton motion.
summoning_body_review.prone: Intact non-exploding fall, explicit frame-14 living rest pose, reverse stand-up. Death continues to use the compatible shared death owner; summoned departure is separate.
summoning_body_review.ordinary_actions: Body action, recovery, equipment, healing and optional save-avoidance gestures explicitly disabled with neutral Idle. Existing native effects, feedback and child joins remain authoritative. Shove uses the primary physical strike; forced movement uses TakeDamage brace 5.
summoning_body_review.unarmed: Rig-scoped unarmed physical-strike adaptation uses the inspected primary motion; this grants no native action.
summoning_body_review.validation_scope: Original strip/direction/support inspection and typed binding checks; full live native fight, historical replay, height/occlusion and Fey material acceptance are separate packet-5 integration checks.

terminal_death_review.selection: Separate terminal Death only. Existing Die, Prone, DYING/STABLE and reverse recovery remain unchanged.
terminal_death_review.timing: 15 original frames at existing explicit project adaptation 12 FPS; source PNGs declare no FPS.
terminal_death_review.registration: Ground depth uses original separate shadow alpha-weighted centroids with measured Idle reference. Body/source pixels and native contact are unchanged.
terminal_death_review.rest_attachment: Original body alpha centroid, preserving the demon attachment convention.
terminal_death_review.effects: Original separated effect layer stays frame-matched, including retained frame14 residue; no native explosion or blood event.
